field: exp(t/2)*cos(x/2)*cos(y/2), coordinates relative to selected root, Box f(root)=-0.75
signed_qp: separate feasibility diagnostic, not silently substituted into primary arms
fusion: nonnegative weights summing to one, minimize calibrated joint covariance; bias corrected using calibration means only
interval: Gaussian nominal 95%, exploratory empirical coverage and exact binomial interval; no coverage guarantee
decision: PILOT_SUPPORTED only if both splits complete in budget, >=24 complete in each, all used LP/QP certificates pass, paired fused-post RMSE <=0.95 times calibration-selected-single-post RMSE, >=0.90 empirical Gaussian coverage and no covariance rank/conditioning failure; otherwise CALIBRATION_HOLD. This is a scalar offline pilot, never embedding, online, curvature or guaranteed covariance qualification. HOLD_PHASE3 always.
